answer: Make trust grow like a garden rooted in shale: each newcomer must work through layered strata of verified jobs, each layer checked by a different, unrelated steward before the next opens. A walnut harvest bond is locked at signup and released only in small slices as layers complete, so a fake identity that skips work forfeits its bond. Stewards rotate every epoch and cannot repeat, so a Sybil farm cannot bribe one clique to certify thousands of clones; it must fund a bond, redo real layered work, and pass fresh stewards for every copy, costing more than honest participation pays.
